source_instruction: i am looking for dark denim color ethylene vinyl ultra train of size 10, 3rd generation for  men
query: I swear I spent ten minutes this morning chasing my neighbor’s runaway tabby cat all up and down the apartment complex parking lot, because the little guy snuck out when his owner was hauling in a giant bag of cat litter and bolted straight for the wooded edge by the dumpster. I tripped over a loose curb chunk at one point and scuffed the knee of my favorite faded work pants, and I was fully ready to give up until he curled up under a parked pickup and let me scoop him up like he hadn’t just made me run a full 5k for no reason. The neighbor brought over a still-warm loaf of banana bread as a thank you an hour later, and it’s got chocolate chips and walnut chunks baked right in, so I’m already halfway through slicing off a second piece even though I told myself I’d skip extra sweets this week. I’m looking through the men’s athletic shoes here, and I need a pair made with ethylene propylene for sure, my budget max is $120. I want the colorway that’s dark denim with red orange accents, obviously. Oh and don’t forget to grab me that one too, yeah?
